blocks.text: Searidge Foundation is a leading residential treatment center situated in the scenic Annapolis Valley in Nova Scotia, Canada. The center offers a comprehensive approach to addiction recovery and deals specifically with co-occurring mental health conditions. At Searidge, the goal is to provide evidence-based therapies and holistic services that will help sustain long-term recovery. Clients receive individualized support and attention in an intimate setting that caters to just 12 residents. The therapy includes cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT), group therapy, journaling, acupuncture, meditation, yoga, creative art therapy, and recreational therapy.

The center offers various amenities that include a heated pool, a library, and a game room with a pool table. All clients are provided with nutritious gourmet meals that are locally sourced and contain only the freshest ingredients.

blocks.text: As a leader in effective treatment for substance abuse, Searidge Drug Rehab and its sister drug rehab center, Sobriety Home in Quebec, offer a comprehensive recovery plan for drug addiction and concurrent disorders. centre.about_html:
Searidge Foundation is a leading residential treatment center situated in the scenic Annapolis Valley in Nova Scotia, Canada. The center offers a comprehensive approach to addiction recovery and deals specifically with co-occurring mental health conditions. At Searidge, the goal is to provide evidence-based therapies and holistic services that will help sustain long-term recovery. Clients receive individualized support and attention in an intimate setting that caters to just 12 residents. The therapy includes cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT), group therapy, journaling, acupuncture, meditation, yoga, creative art therapy, and recreational therapy.

 

The facility overlooks the Annapolis Basin and is designed to provide an ideal environment for healing. The surrounding area is serene and green and offers plenty of space for walking or hiking. Searidge believes that privacy is an important element of successful addiction recovery, and as such, each client is provided with their own private room with a full bathroom. The center offers various amenities that include a heated pool, a library, and a game room with a pool table. All clients are provided with nutritious gourmet meals that are locally sourced and contain only the freshest ingredients.

Recreational Activities

Clients at Searidge Foundation are encouraged to engage in recreational activities as part of their addiction recovery. The center offers access to various recreational activities on and off-site. On-site, clients can enjoy the heated swimming pool, the library, and the game room. Off-site, there’s an opportunity to engage in activities such as whale watching, white water rafting, horseback riding, and group sports. The center also offers access to hiking trails for clients who love nature walks. The goal is to help clients achieve a balance between their recovery and relaxation time.

Philosophy and Values

The core philosophy of Searidge Foundation is to provide the highest quality of care for anyone struggling with addiction and mental health disorders. The center believes in offering a holistic approach to addiction recovery that addresses the psychological, medical, pharmaceutical, nutritional, alternative, and spiritual practices that will support long-term recovery. Searidge aims to create an environment that is supportive, welcoming, and encourages clients to achieve their goals in safety. The center’s staff is committed to treating each client with respect, compassion, and understanding.




Searidge Foundation- Center Overview

Searidge Drug Rehab and Addiction Treatment Centre has been providing effective drug addiction treatment services in Nova Scotia, Canada since its establishment. The center operates with the aim of making quality drug rehab affordable and accessible to individuals with drug addiction dependencies. Searidge Drug Rehab is known for its highly individualised recovery programs and its commitment to maintaining a consistently excellent level of quality. The center accommodates only 12 residents at a time, which allows for a more personalised approach to recovery and ensures that each resident receives the best treatment possible.

As a leader in effective treatment for substance abuse, Searidge Drug Rehab and its sister drug rehab center, Sobriety Home in Quebec, offer a comprehensive recovery plan for drug addiction and concurrent disorders. Residents and their families are provided with the necessary support and guidance through the Sobriety Home Treatment Program to help them overcome addiction. The center is dedicated to improving addiction treatment techniques and supports ongoing research on PTSD and addiction memory at McGill University, led by Dr. Alain Brunet, as well as on addiction and anxiety disorder at the University of Florida. Searidge Drug Rehab and Addiction Treatment Centre is committed to delivering quality care to individuals with drug addiction and providing them with the tools they need to achieve lasting recovery.

raw_html:
Searidge Foundation is a leading residential treatment center situated in the scenic Annapolis Valley in Nova Scotia, Canada. The center offers a comprehensive approach to addiction recovery and deals specifically with co-occurring mental health conditions. At Searidge, the goal is to provide evidence-based therapies and holistic services that will help sustain long-term recovery. Clients receive individualized support and attention in an intimate setting that caters to just 12 residents. The therapy includes cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT), group therapy, journaling, acupuncture, meditation, yoga, creative art therapy, and recreational therapy.

 

The facility overlooks the Annapolis Basin and is designed to provide an ideal environment for healing. The surrounding area is serene and green and offers plenty of space for walking or hiking. Searidge believes that privacy is an important element of successful addiction recovery, and as such, each client is provided with their own private room with a full bathroom. The center offers various amenities that include a heated pool, a library, and a game room with a pool table. All clients are provided with nutritious gourmet meals that are locally sourced and contain only the freshest ingredients.

Recreational Activities

Clients at Searidge Foundation are encouraged to engage in recreational activities as part of their addiction recovery. The center offers access to various recreational activities on and off-site. On-site, clients can enjoy the heated swimming pool, the library, and the game room. Off-site, there’s an opportunity to engage in activities such as whale watching, white water rafting, horseback riding, and group sports. The center also offers access to hiking trails for clients who love nature walks. The goal is to help clients achieve a balance between their recovery and relaxation time.

Philosophy and Values

The core philosophy of Searidge Foundation is to provide the highest quality of care for anyone struggling with addiction and mental health disorders. The center believes in offering a holistic approach to addiction recovery that addresses the psychological, medical, pharmaceutical, nutritional, alternative, and spiritual practices that will support long-term recovery. Searidge aims to create an environment that is supportive, welcoming, and encourages clients to achieve their goals in safety. The center’s staff is committed to treating each client with respect, compassion, and understanding.




Searidge Foundation- Center Overview

Searidge Drug Rehab and Addiction Treatment Centre has been providing effective drug addiction treatment services in Nova Scotia, Canada since its establishment. The center operates with the aim of making quality drug rehab affordable and accessible to individuals with drug addiction dependencies. Searidge Drug Rehab is known for its highly individualised recovery programs and its commitment to maintaining a consistently excellent level of quality. The center accommodates only 12 residents at a time, which allows for a more personalised approach to recovery and ensures that each resident receives the best treatment possible.

As a leader in effective treatment for substance abuse, Searidge Drug Rehab and its sister drug rehab center, Sobriety Home in Quebec, offer a comprehensive recovery plan for drug addiction and concurrent disorders. Residents and their families are provided with the necessary support and guidance through the Sobriety Home Treatment Program to help them overcome addiction. The center is dedicated to improving addiction treatment techniques and supports ongoing research on PTSD and addiction memory at McGill University, led by Dr. Alain Brunet, as well as on addiction and anxiety disorder at the University of Florida. Searidge Drug Rehab and Addiction Treatment Centre is committed to delivering quality care to individuals with drug addiction and providing them with the tools they need to achieve lasting recovery.
